parameters.name: CiphertextBlob
parameters.description: The ciphertext of the data key encrypted by using a CMK.

parameters.name: EncryptionContext
parameters.description: A JSON string that consists of key-value pairs. If you specify this parameter when you use a CMK to encrypt the data key, an equivalent value is required here. For more information, see [EncryptionContext](~~42975~~).

parameters.name: WrappingAlgorithm
parameters.description:
The encryption algorithm based on which you want to use the public key specified by PublicKeyBlob to encrypt the data key. For more information about encryption algorithms, see [AsymmetricDecrypt](~~148130~~).

Valid values:

*   RSAES_OAEP_SHA\_256
*   RSAES_OAEP_SHA\_1
*   SM2PKE

parameters.name: WrappingKeySpec
parameters.description:
The key type of the public key specified by PublicKeyBlob. For more information about key types, see [Introduction to asymmetric keys](~~148147~~).

Valid values:

*   RSA\_2048
*   EC_SM2

example.unifiedCli: aliyun kms export-data-key --ciphertext-blob ODZhOWVmZDktM2QxNi00ODk0LWJkNGYtMWZjNDNmM2YyYWJmS7FmDBBQ0BkKsQrtRnidtPwirmDcS0ZuJCU41xxAAWk4Z8qsADfbV0b+i6kQmlvj79dJdGOvtX69Uycs901q00000000 --encryption-context Example=Example --public-key-blob  --wrapping-key-spec RSA_2048 --wrapping-algorithm RSAES_OAEP_SHA_256 --dry-run false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun kms ExportDataKey --region cn-hangzhou --WrappingKeySpec RSA_2048 --EncryptionContext '{"Example":"Example"}' --PublicKeyBlob '' --CiphertextBlob 'ODZhOWVmZDktM2QxNi00ODk0LWJkNGYtMWZjNDNmM2YyYWJmS7FmDBBQ0BkKsQrtRnidtPwirmDcS0ZuJCU41xxAAWk4Z8qsADfbV0b+i6kQmlvj79dJdGOvtX69Uycs901q00000000' --DryRun false --WrappingAlgorithm RSAES_OAEP_SHA_256
